_doc: Owner switch for router tools whose enabled_if is `user:enable`. A tool listed here counts as enabled for the shortlist and preflight. Listing a tool does NOT create credentials, accounts, servers or installs; tools that need a key, MCP login or hosted account stay unusable until that exists, and paid ones spend money only when their own key is set. Change this file with a plan/DECISIONS.md entry.

enabled.stitch: manual Google Stitch loop; no API, user pastes results back
enabled.scroll_world_skill: vendored project skill; its video chain still needs Monid or Higgsfield credentials
enabled.jev_advisory: TYPESAFE_API_KEY present in root .env; shadow mode only
enabled.google_flow_manual: owner-run free studio (50 credits per day) for previz; no API and no commercial-grade output on the free tier
